name: extension-large-table-page-size
description: The large-table-page-size extension applied alongside multi-column-sections, so the fixture pins BOTH the geometry changes and the precedence rule FR-031c requires to be predictable. The reference is a five-page document whose page sizes alternate A4 portrait, A4 landscape, A4 portrait, A3 landscape, A4 portrait: a regression that failed to restore the document's geometry after a wide table would change every later page and is caught by the page-size sequence alone. The final page carries a marked table inside a multi-column region, which must render inline on a portrait page because the column layout wins.
